text: 외래 방문 방문이고 입원 방문인 환자.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_occurrence vo WHERE vo.person_id = p.person_id AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (9202))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_occurrence vo WHERE vo.person_id = p.person_id AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (9201)));
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "외래 방문" → visit_occurrence.visit_concept_id IN (9202)
  - "입원" → visit_occurrence.visit_concept_id IN (9201)

text: 심부전 진단 또는 입원 방문인 환자.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (316139))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_occurrence vo WHERE vo.person_id = p.person_id AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (9201)));
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "심부전" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (316139)
  - "입원" → visit_occurrence.visit_concept_id IN (9201)

text: 돌연심장사 또는 뇌졸중의 최초 발생일을 환자별로 집계해 주세요.
query: WITH outcome_events AS ( SELECT d.person_id, d.death_date AS event_date FROM death d WHERE d.cause_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4317150)) UNION ALL SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS event_date FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (381316)) ) SELECT oe.person_id, MIN(oe.event_date) AS first_event_date FROM outcome_events oe GROUP BY oe.person_id;
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "돌연심장사" → death.cause_concept_id IN (4317150)
  - "뇌졸중" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (381316)

text: 현재 연도 기준 연령이 70세 초과이고 85세 미만이며 외래 방문 이력이 있고 수축기혈압 측정값이 160을 넘는 환자 집단을 추출하라.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - p.year_of_birth) > 70 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - p.year_of_birth) < 85 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_occurrence vo WHERE vo.person_id = p.person_id AND vo.visit_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (9202))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3004249)) AND m.value_as_number > 160);
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "수축기혈압" → measurement.measurement_concept_id IN (3004249)
  - "측정값" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (315078)
  - "외래 방문" → visit_occurrence.visit_concept_id IN (9202)

query: SELECT op.person_id, op.observation_period_start_date, op.observation_period_end_date FROM observation_period op WHERE op.observation_period_start_date <= DATE '2008-03-31' AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATE '2003-10-01';

text: 현재 연도 기준 연령 60세 이상이고 75세 이하이고 본태성 고혈압 진단이고 수축기혈압 값이 130 이상인 환자.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - p.year_of_birth) >= 60 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - p.year_of_birth) <= 75 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (320128))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3004249)) AND m.value_as_number >= 130);
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "본태성 고혈압" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (320128)
  - "수축기혈압" → measurement.measurement_concept_id IN (3004249)

text: 수축기혈압 값이 170 초과 또는 이차성 고혈압 진단인 환자.
query: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3004249)) AND m.value_as_number > 170) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (319826)));
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "수축기혈압" → measurement.measurement_concept_id IN (3004249)
  - "이차성 고혈압" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (319826)

text: 수축기혈압 값이 180 초과 또는 이차성 고혈압 진단인 환자.
query: WITH systolic_bp_gt_180 AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.person_id FROM measurement m WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3004249)) AND m.value_as_number > 180), secondary_htn AS (SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (319826))) SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM systolic_bp_gt_180 s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM secondary_htn h WHERE h.person_id = p.person_id);
input:
[재료]
개념 값 조건:
  - "수축기혈압" → measurement.measurement_concept_id IN (3004249)
  - "이차성 고혈압" → condition_occurrence.condition_concept_id IN (319826)
